\bBrock: Hey \PN! Good to see you here. Let's have a good battle.
\bBrock: Wow \PN, strong as ever. Let me know if you'd like me to groom your Pokémon.
\bBrock: I've really improved, haven't I?
\rMisty: Oh, it's \PN! I still remember how we met, with you stealing my bike. I'm gonna pay you back for that now!
\rMisty: Grr, I'll get you next time!
\rMisty: Yay, I win!
\bLt. Surge: Hah, it's \PN. Your Pikachu may have beaten my Raichu before, but not this time!
\bLt. Surge: Nice one kid. I'll shock you next time!
\bLt. Surge: Haha! I shocked you into surrender!
\rErika: Yawn... Oh, it's \PN. Try not to rely on a disobedient Pokémon this time!
\rErika: Oh my, you've become so genuinely strong! I suppose I dozed off when I shouldn't have.
\rErika: Oh dear, still so cocky?
\rSabrina: I had a vision of this moment, \PN. Let's battle and witness the future with our own eyes!
\rSabrina: I already foresaw your victory.
\rSabrina: I already foresaw your defeat.
\rJanine: I suppose you don't know who I am, \PN. I'm Janine, Koga's daughter. Let's see if you're as strong as my father says you are!
\rJanine: You truly are a champion!
\rJanine: Guess I can hold my own against the strongest out there!
\bBlaine: We meet again, \PN! We're not in a volcano this time, but this is still a great place to battle.
\bBlaine: Yeah, that set my heart aflame!
\bBlaine: What a blazing battle. Until we meet again, \PN!
\bBill: Hey, it's \PN. I'm not much of a battler, but I'll still give you a good battle to thank you for getting me out of that Kabuto costume!
\bBill: Haha, as expected.
\bBill: Woah, didn't expect that!
\rLorelei: Oh my, it's \PN? Champion or not, I freeze all opponents solid!
\rLorelei: Pardon. You are quite the strong trainer now, \PN.
\rLorelei: Stopped you frozen in your tracks, according to strategy.
\rAgatha: \PN, huh. Very well, I won't hold back this time.
\rAgatha: My, my. These old bones didn't stand a chance!
\rAgatha: Eheheh!
\bGary: Hey, \PN! I'm gonna beat you this time!
\bGary: Hah, that was close. I'll beat you next time!
\bGary: Smell ya later, \PN!
\bOak: Oh, it's \PN! Surprised to see me here? I used to be quite the battler back in my day. Let's see if I can still give you a good battle!
\bOak: As expected, I couldn't keep you with you. Keep going!
\bOak: I've still got strength left in these old bones!
\bFalkner: \PN, you'll need more a jolt of electricity to take down my birds. Still think you stand a chance?
\bFalkner: The winds blew for your victory this time. Remember to keep soaring high!
\bFalkner: The winds blew for my victory this time. I'll keep soaring hihgher and higher!
\bBugsy: Let me demonstrate what I've learned from my studies, \PN!
\bBugsy: Back to the books.
\bBugsy: Up and at 'em!
\rWhitney: Let's do this fair and square, \PN. I'll show you the power of cuteness!
\rWhitney: Hey! You're not allowed to do that!
\rWhitney: Don't blame me, it's not my fault.
